newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut t-bill issue raises 585.8 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Beirut t-bill issue raises 585.8 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly Treasury bill issue of May 1 raised 585.8 billion Lebanese pounds, according to finance ministry results issued on Monday.
The previous issue raised 289.7 billion pounds.
The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 142.2 billion pounds. It raised the following amounts (in billion of pounds, previous week in brackets):
The central bank said only 15 percent of all competitive bids -- those made by Lebanese institutions -- were accepted up to the discount rate and yield for three-month and six-month bills.

The Bank restricted the acceptance of non-competitive bids -- those made by private individuals and foreign investors -- for three- and six-month bills. It approved only 15 percent up to the discount rate and yield for three-month and six-month bills .
However, all competitive and non-competitive bids were accepted for the 12-month and 24-month bills for the fourth consecutive week, the Bank said.
The Lebanese pound closed at 1,543.25 to the U.S. dollar on Monday from 1,543.5 last Monday and 1,579 a year ago.
